title: Emoji Font Setup for Devcontainer
description: All GUI apps inside the devcontainer render emoji glyphs as placeholders. Add zero-touch emoji font installation and fontconfig defaults to the devcontainer, and apply the same fix in the running container without a rebuild.
summary: Installed Noto Color Emoji in the devcontainer image, enforced fontconfig fallback through lifecycle scripts, refreshed caches in the running container, and verified emoji codepoints resolve correctly for GUI apps.
